modalities.evidence: This dataset contains the EEG used in the paper

output.population: Twenty healthy participants (7 woman; age: 25.2, SD = 4.1) plus one patient with intractable epilepsy
output.summary: EEG recorded during a tactile detection task studying how evidence accumulation relates to perceptual consciousness and monitoring. Vibrotactile stimuli were applied to the right wrist after individual detection thresholds were estimated.
